In repo C:\Users\mariu\ventures\subrogation-recovery, create faithful Norwegian bokmål translations as sibling files named <name>.no.md for these Markdown files: README.md -> README.no.md, ARCHITECTURE.md -> ARCHITECTURE.no.md, deploy/aws.md -> deploy/aws.no.md. Read each with the Read tool and write the sibling with the Write tool. Do NOT modify English originals, do not git commit, do not touch src/. Rules: translate prose, headings, table text and list items fully and faithfully; do NOT translate code, code blocks, shell commands, file/dir paths, module names, identifiers, env vars, API routes, brand/company/product names (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Verisk, AWS services etc.), URLs, numbers/figures/dates, A/B/C grades, or relative link targets (link text may be translated; keep targets such as ARCHITECTURE.md and deploy/aws.md pointing at the English files). NOTE: the English README.md "Repository map" has corrupted control characters (e.g. backspace/formfeed/tab before business/, financial/, technical/, fundraising/, hiring/); in the Norwegian copy write these paths correctly as `business/`, `financial/`, `technical/`, `fundraising/`, `hiring/` with backticks. Preserve Markdown structure exactly (heading levels, tables, code fences, bullets). Use natural bokmål. The very first line of each output file must be this banner, followed by a blank line, then the translation:
> **Uoffisiell oversettelse (bokmål).** Bekvemmelighetsoversettelse, ikke juridisk/finansiell fagoversettelse. Ved avvik gjelder den engelske originalen. Juridisk og skattemessig innhold er utkast og må gjennomgås av advokat/rådgiver før bruk.
Do not use ruflo/ruvnet tooling. Final report: one line listing files written.
